scope: Binary-treatment propensity and causal numerical contracts plus supplied-uplift-score evaluation; restricted method coverage, not whole JMP Pro Causal Treatment/Uplift parity.
jmp_edition: JMP Pro for Causal Treatment and Uplift per official help
primary_source_notes: JMP19.2 assumption/estimand/advanced matching pages read directly. Equations encoded as explicit contracts below; no arbitrary displayed-image equivalence inferred.
Direct19.2 Uplift page unavailable through browser tool; official JMP19 Consumer Research PDF explains the interaction-partition learner, which this implementation does not claim.

common_contract.numeric: Finite rectangular nonempty <=100000rows,<=66columns,<=1000000cells,<=16384finite args. Per-method work and dimensions stricter.
common_contract.positivity: All causal estimation/matching/evaluation input propensities must be strictly in(0,1). Optional clipping truncates only interior scores, reports count, does not cure failed identification and may bias inference.
common_contract.causal_assumptions: Consistency and well-defined interventions/no interference, conditional exchangeability given measured pre-treatment covariates, positivity and independent observations. These are not established by a balanced sample or good logistic fit.
common_contract.nuisance_provenance: Supply proper out-of-fold or independent nuisance predictions when needed; input cannot verify training provenance. Plain IPW conditional SE omits fitted nuisance uncertainty; AIPW needs orthogonality rate/regularity conditions.
common_contract.outcomes: One actual observed factual outcome per observation; m0/m1 are predictions, never simultaneously observed potential outcomes.
common_contract.scope: No actual JMP executable comparison, continuous treatment, missing outcomes, multiarm, clustered rows or finite-sample causal guarantee.

operations.description: Training-prefix logistic propensity model: [features...,treatment0/1]; [n_train,ridge=0,max_iterations=100,tolerance=1e-8]. Suffix labels ignored; saved preprocessing.
operations.data: [features...,treatment]; prefix training labels0/1, suffix labels ignored; <=32 features, <=10000 training rows; n_train>parameter_count
args: ridge: 0..1e12,default0; summed binomial negative log likelihood +ridge/2*squared standardized slopes
operations.estimator: Analytic Newton/IRLS with backtracking, unpenalized intercept, population feature scales fit on training prefix, original-unit display coefficients and stable saved vector. Unpenalized separated designs reject finite-MLE claims. Return actual final gradient/objective/converged flag; no uncertainty or causal identification is inferred.

operations.description: Saved training-only logistic propensity scoring: feature rows; propensity_fit.predict_parameters.
operations.data: [features...] with same ordered predictors; intercept-only model uses ignored scalar dummy
operations.estimator: Stable origin-plus-offset feature normalization and logistic scoring. Query rows do not refit centering/scales. Returned probabilities can numerically reach0/1; downstream causal estimators reject endpoints rather than silently asserting positivity.

operations.description: Raw-score overlap and weighted covariate balance: [features...,treatment,propensity]; [estimand0ATE/1ATT=0,explicit_clip=0]. Fixed baseline pooled SD, ESS; both groups>=2.
operations.data: >=1 numeric covariate, treatment0/1, propensity strictly(0,1); >=2rows per treatment group
args: explicit_clip:0none(default),otherwise0<clip<.5; truncate interior input scores to[clip,1-clip] for weights only
operations.estimator: ATE weights T/e and(1-T)/(1-e); ATT weights T and(1-T)*e/(1-e). Weighted mean differences use fixed unweighted pooled sample SD=sqrt((sample_var_T+sample_var_C)/2), not a post-weighting denominator. Return unweighted/weighted SMD, weighted means, baseline SD, treated/control ESS=(sumw)^2/sumw^2 and raw input propensity common-support interval. Common-support=null if empirical ranges do not intersect; outside count uses raw scores even when weights are clipped. Undefined infinite SMD is null; exact constant-equal feature SMD0. Balance is a design diagnostic, not proof of exchangeability.

operations.description: Greedy1:1 ATT matching with explicit absolute caliper: [outcome,treatment,propensity]; [caliper=1,replacement1/0=1,metric0probability/1logit=0]. Matched-subset effect; SE null.
args: caliper: nonnegative absolute distance in selected score units,default1
operations.estimator: Process treated rows in input order; choose nearest admissible control, exact distance ties lowest original control index. Optional control reuse; unmatched treated rows excluded and reported. Estimate is mean factual treated-minus-matched-control outcome difference over matched treated subset. No generic independent-pair SE is returned; control reuse and estimated matching need valid matching inference. JMP caliper is multiplied by estimated score SD and its matched report fits a mixed model; neither convention is claimed here.

operations.description: Hajek IPW ATE/ATT with fixed-nuisance delta-method SE: [outcome,treatment,propensity]; [estimand0ATE/1ATT=0,explicit_clip=0].
args: explicit_clip:0none(default),otherwise(0,.5); changes effective weighting and can introduce bias
operations.estimator: ATE compares separately normalized weighted means with w1=T/e,w0=(1-T)/(1-e); ATT uses w1=T,w0=(1-T)*e/(1-e). IF_i=n*[normalized_w1_i*(Y_i-mu1)-normalized_w0_i*(Y_i-mu0)]. SE is sample SD(IF)/sqrt(n); fixed95%normal interval. This conditions on fixed supplied nuisance scores and does not include fitted-propensity first-order uncertainty. Cross-fitting alone does not make plain IPW orthogonal. Correct nuisance identification, consistency/no interference, conditional exchangeability and positivity are caller assumptions.

operations.description: Canonical AIPW ATE/ATT scores with influence SE: [outcome,treatment,propensity,m0,m1]; [estimand0ATE/1ATT=0,explicit_clip=0]. External nuisance fitting required.
operations.estimator: ATE score psi=m1-m0+T*(Y-m1)/e-(1-T)*(Y-m0)/(1-e); estimate=meanpsi,IF=psi-estimate. ATT numerator g=T*(Y-m0)-(1-T)*e/(1-e)*(Y-m0); estimate=sumg/n_treated,IF=(g-T*estimate)/treatment_prevalence. ATT does not use m1. SE=sample SD(IF)/sqrt(n),fixed95%normal interval. Nuisance predictions are externally supplied; calibrated inference needs independent observations, valid identification, suitable cross-fitting/Donsker and nuisance-product rate conditions. Input cannot verify these conditions.

operations.description: Supplied-score uplift/Qini evaluation: [factual_outcome,treatment,predicted_effect_score,assignment_propensity]; []. Grouped-score HT gain; no uplift-tree fitting.
operations.data: [actual observed outcome,treatment0/1,predicted effect ranking score,known/valid assignment propensity strictly(0,1)], both groups present
operations.estimator: Sort supplied scores descending and group exact ties. z=T*Y/e-(1-T)*Y/(1-e). Gain at selection fraction k/n=sum_selected(z)/n. Qini=gain-fraction*finalgain; report trapezoid AUUC and Qini area. Initial threshold null denotes above all scores. Appropriate held-out evaluation needs randomized known assignment or observational exchangeability/valid propensity, plus consistency/positivity. Actual outcomes are factual observations, not individual treatment effects; observed treated outcomes cannot be used as counterfactual truth. This evaluates a supplied ranking and is not the JMP interaction-significance uplift partition learner.
